description:
Are you a cat lover, a cat parent or even an animal lover who loves supporting small businesses? We would LOVE for you to be a part of our mission: To spread love & awareness about cats! <3

Curious Cat Company is a small, one year old business run by a tiny team of 2 crazy cat lovers. We collaborate with artists and local small businesses, who receive a share of our revenues, to create unique, artsy, sustainable & locally made products that celebrate cats & cat culture. We also support local animal welfare NGOs.

It has become extremely expensive for a small business like ours to thrive during this pandemic. We are looking for genuine cat lovers who like what we do and want to spread love and understanding about these wonderful felines as our brand ambassadors.

I hope you like our brand and decide to help us promote it <3

If you have any questions or suggestions, please do write to us on contact@curiouscatcompany.com
term_and_condition:
Let's spread Cat love! <3 

  • As a Curious Cat Co Ambassador, your mission is to spread awareness and love for Cats through promoting Curious Cat Co's brand & products. 
  • Commission is 5% on most products & 10% on selected products & collections
  • Commission amount is payable when amount exceeds Rs. 1000
  • Commission Dues will be transferred by bank transfers by the 5th of the following month
  • Please update your payment information through your account once you sign up
  • Referrals are tracked through your affiliate link and your assigned coupon code which you can share with potential customers
  • Once selected, you will receive an email with your very own discount coupon, which you can use every time you shop on Curious Cat Company's web store.
  • You will also receive access to a content bank which you may use for promoting the brand & our products. 
  • Commissions on COD orders will only be payable once the order is delivered and amount is paid without any rejections or RTOs.

Here are a list of other guidelines & terms.

1. Approve or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

You will be assigned a unique link which will help us track the referrals generated by you. You can share this link with potential customers.

This affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. 

You will also be assigned a unique discount code which you can share with your potential customers to incentivise them to purchase CCC products. 

If customer clicks on both the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. 

3. Commissions and payment

When a customer referred by you visits the website using the link you provide and makes a purchase using the code you share with them, you are entitled to a commission.

Standard commission receivable is 5%. 

Certain products or collections may have higher commissions. 

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings.

All payouts happen by the 5th of the following month. Eg. payouts for April will happen by 5th June.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed.

Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order.

Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab.

Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.  

Commissions will not be payable on COD transactions that are rejected and sent back to us.


4. Marketing tool

You may use content from the CCC website, social media pages or the content bank provided to you fo promotion of CCC and our products.

You may also use your own content.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate.

If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we cannot track them and thus cannot pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookie days are mentioned on the Affiliate registration form.

The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate 


7. Removal from Referral Program

Use of profanity, abusive language, politically incorrect content or any action that reflects negatively on the brand will be subject to review and immediate termination of the affiliate's involvement with Curious Cat Company.

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: contact@curiouscatcompany.com


Go forward and spread the cat love!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to contact@curiouscatcompany.com for support.
